<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="ORgVvvktvvLfnAuyAOiY"> <mxGraphModel dx="2445" dy="1001" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml casos-de-uso
title Diagrama de Casos de Uso - SetlistGen
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
left to right direction

actor \"DJ\" as DJ

rectangle \"SetlistGen\" {
 usecase \"CU-01\nIniciar sesión /\nGestionar cuenta de DJ\" as CU01
 usecase \"CU-02\nSeleccionar biblioteca local\" as CU02
 usecase \"CU-03\nActualizar biblioteca\" as CU03
 usecase \"CU-04\nEstablecer parámetros\npara generar setlist\" as CU04
 usecase \"CU-05\nEditar setlist\" as CU05
 usecase \"CU-06\nGuardar/Actualizar setlist\" as CU06
 usecase \"CU-07\nConsultar setlists guardados\" as CU07
 usecase \"CU-08\nExportar setlist\n(opcional)\" as CU08
}

DJ --> CU01
DJ --> CU02
DJ --> CU03
DJ --> CU04
DJ --> CU05
DJ --> CU06
DJ --> CU07
DJ --> CU08

CU05 .> CU04 : <<extend>>
@enduml",
